|translation='''Title:''' Stormtrooper.

'''Card text:''' May deploy without cost at a site where an Imperial with ability greater than 2 is present.

'''Lore:''' A nameless member of elite shock troops who swear complete loyalty to the Emperor. Follows orders unconditionally and does not hesitate to sacrifice his life for a mission. A frontline rapid-strike force.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese free-deployment sentence does not explicitly say your Imperial; the English says one of your Imperials. The Japanese lore calls the trooper nameless, where the English says one of countless troops. Both printed faces have deploy 1, power 1, ability 1 and forfeit 2. The conditional free deployment is separate from the printed deploy statistic.<ref name="comparison">[ Japanese printed face], PSA; [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/1/1d/Premiere-D-stormtrooper.gif English printed face].</ref>
